step_mode_prompt: ⚙️ Step 12 of 12 — Trading Mode Type the number of your Trading Mode: 1 = Regular Win = next trade doubles. Loss = stay same amount until win then double. 2 = 1-Step Compounding Trade 1 loss = Trade 2 doubles. After Trade 2 result = restart. 3 = 2-Step Compounding 2 consecutive losses then double twice. After final result = restart. 4 = 3-Step Compounding 3 consecutive losses then double three times. After final result = restart. 5 = Martingale (1-MTG) Every loss doubles the amount. First win = restart. 6 = Oscar's Grind Loss = same amount. Win = increase by 1 unit. At +1 unit profit = restart. Works at 30% win rate. 7 = Anti-Martingale Win = double amount. Loss = restart at base. After 3 wins in a row = restart. 8 = Flat Bet Every trade uses the same base amount. Safest mode. 9 = Fibonacci Loss = move forward in sequence. Win = move 2 steps back. Works at 40% win rate. 10 = D'Alembert Loss = increase by 1 unit. Win = decrease by 1 unit (minimum 1 unit). Works at 35% win rate. (Type a number from 1 to 10. Example: 1)
step_mode_invalid: ❌ Please type a number from 1 to 10. Example: 1
